load_imas_data: load IMAS IDS data from a netCDF file for equilibrium, core_profiles, or core_sources
profile_conditions_from_IMAS: extract plasma profile conditions from IMAS core_profiles IDS data
plasma_composition_from_IMAS: extract plasma composition from IMAS core_profiles IDS data
to_xarray: convert IMAS IDS data to an xarray dataset for profile extraction
torax_path: resolve the torax installation path for locating data files
